info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Direct Debit Mandate Management API
info.description: The Direct Debit Mandate Management API enables users to modify existing direct debit mandates efficiently. This API is designed primarily for banks and financial institutions that need to update mandate details, ensuring up-to-date information for recurring transactions. Typical use cases include updating customer account information or changing payment amounts. By facilitating seamless updates, this API supports improved operational efficiency and enhances customer satisfaction.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific Direct Debit Mandate identified by its ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields that you want to modify in your request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a direct debit mandate in the trade banking system. The data provided should comply with the specified schema to ensure proper processing of the request.
